"""The pre viral metric and its liveness probe must read the SAME engagement keys.

_FAVE_KEYS is the declared set of spellings an archived evidence item may carry an engagement count
under. pre_viral_observability reports the prune guard "live" when any of them is present, and
decide_prune spares a handle only when the metric can actually read one. If the two sides drift, the
report announces a live guard while the guard is blind, and a handle with a real pre viral catch is
auto disabled under a header claiming it was protected. Every declared key must be readable by the
metric, whatever that list happens to contain.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import importlib

from lib import parse_ts

Y = importlib.import_module("yield")

NOW = parse_ts("2026-08-28T12:00:00Z")
ORIGIN = (Y.KIND_HANDLE, "founder")


def test_the_metric_reads_every_key_the_liveness_probe_declares():
    for k in Y._FAVE_KEYS:
        ev = [{"origin_handle": "founder", "url": "https://x.com/founder/1", k: 90}]
        assert Y._evidence_is_pre_viral(ev, ORIGIN, 500.0) is True, k


def test_a_catch_tagged_with_any_declared_key_counts_as_pre_viral():
    for k in Y._FAVE_KEYS:
        recs = [{"opportunity_id": "op-" + k, "first_seen": "2026-08-26T00:00:00Z",
                 "last_seen": "2026-08-26T00:00:00Z",
                 "evidence": [{"origin_handle": "founder",
                               "url": "https://x.com/founder/1", k: 90}]}]
        pulls = [{"run_id": "r1", "ts": "2026-08-26T08:00:00Z", "handle": "founder", "pulled": 4}]
        st = Y.compute_yield(recs, pulls, NOW, Y.yield_cfg({}))[Y.okey(Y.KIND_HANDLE, "founder")]
        assert st["pre_viral"] == 1, k


def test_the_probe_and_the_metric_agree_on_one_camelcase_count():
    ev = {"origin_handle": "founder", "url": "https://x.com/founder/1", "favoriteCount": 90}
    rec = {"opportunity_id": "op-x", "first_seen": "2026-08-26T00:00:00Z",
           "last_seen": "2026-08-26T00:00:00Z", "evidence": [ev]}
    assert Y.pre_viral_observability([rec], NOW, Y.yield_cfg({}))["state"] == "live"
    assert Y._evidence_is_pre_viral([ev], ORIGIN, 500.0) is True


def test_an_above_threshold_count_is_not_a_pre_viral_catch():
    """Negative control: the metric still discriminates on the threshold, not on mere presence."""
    ev = [{"origin_handle": "founder", "url": "https://x.com/founder/1", "faves": 5000}]
    assert Y._evidence_is_pre_viral(ev, ORIGIN, 500.0) is False
why_realistic: The pre viral guard already had one liveness scare in this file: it read keys the archive writer never persisted, so it looked like protection while it could not fire, and pre_viral_observability was added to measure that. Giving the metric its own shorter key list re-opens the same hole from the other side: the probe reports the guard live on a favoriteCount row while the metric reads nothing, so a handle with a genuine catch is pruned under a header that says it was protected.
